question: When should the ritual substance be consumed in relation to the yoginī assembly?
premises: Drinking or partaking of that substance is enjoined.
It should be done at all times or occasions.
The context is the assembly of yoginīs.
inference: One should always partake of that substance whenever there is an assembly of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat depends on the preceding verses.
plain_english: One should always partake of that whenever there is an assembly of yoginīs.
